id: title:Gilbert09:drop the firewall hint from bigquery and firebase setup

review.posthog_relevance: Changes the user-facing help text shown when selecting a database connector, potentially reducing user confusion regarding firewall requirements for BigQuery and Firebase.
review.reason: Adds a constant array of connectors without network allowlisting and updates a conditional check to exclude them from a firewall hint. This is a localized frontend behavior change.
review.uncertainty: The actual backend implementation and connector behavior are not supplied, so the tier is assigned conservatively based on the observed frontend change.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a frontend React component change. No backend implementation, tests, or configuration changes are supplied. The score cannot be assigned. No tier is assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a constant array of connector names that do not require network allowlisting, and updates a conditional rendering to exclude these connectors from a firewall hint. P1.F1.H1 adds the constant; P1.F1.H2 adds the exclusion check.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the user-facing help text shown when selecting a database connector. The firewall hint is no longer shown for BigQuery and Firebase, while it remains for other database connectors. This could prevent user confusion or unnecessary setup steps, but the backend implementation and actual connector behavior are not supplied. No tier is assigned.
